blurb: Guests take about an hour hot air balloon flight near Dansville, NY, floating from tree top level up to 3,000 feet with views of the Finger Lakes. Flights launch roughly 2 hours before sunset and are followed by a champagne toast. The whole experience takes about two and a half hours including setup and landing.
extraNote: Flights may be cancelled for any reason, even if weather is good · Cancel 60% of flights due to weather · Dansville Fish and Game Club, 79 Gibson Street, Dansville, NY (park near the large oak tree on the right; do not park at the club house). Alternate launch sites: Geneseo Airport, 3400 Big Tree Lane, Geneseo, NY; Poags Hole Hill Climb (passengers park at Burnwell Gas, 70 Gibson Street, Dansville, NY and are transported). Launch site decided day of flight. · Open May through September
